title: Cell dissociation from nasal and bronchial brushings for single-cell RNA-seq
author: Laure-Emmanuelle Zaragosi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qubdwsn
materials: Count with Countess automated cell counter using both sides of chambers. Monitor the percentage of nucleated cells (Hoechst +) and dead cells (GFP+). (Thermo Fisher Scientific, AMQAF1000, Countess™ II FL Automated Cell Counter with Dapi and GFP cubes) Countess report after NucGreen and Hoescht33342 staining Countess bright field image after NucGreen and Hoescht33342 staining Countess Dapi image after NucGreen and Hoescht33342 staining Floid microscope image after NucGreen and Hoescht33342 staining

If cells are processed directly after brushing, use DPBS instead of hypothermosol and go directly to step 4. If transportation or storage is necessary: place tube on ice or in polystyrene box containing ice packs. Brushings can be stored for 60 min in dissociation buffer.

steps.title: Perform nasal brush biopsy
steps.instruction: Have a medical doctor insert a 2.0 mm Medi‑Globe cytology brush (catalog GCB‑02‑18‑120) into the inferior nasal concha zone (UBERON_0005922) and obtain a brush biopsy.

steps.title: Prepare dissociation mix and add brush
steps.instruction: Cut the brush tip, place it in a 5 mL Eppendorf tube containing 1 mL ice‑cold dissociation buffer prepared fresh as follows: 850 µL Hypothermosol, 100 µL protease from Bacillus licheniformis (100 mg/mL stock in PBS) to give a final protease concentration of 10 mg/mL, and 50 µL 10 mM EDTA to give a final EDTA concentration of 0.5 mM. Mix gently.

steps.title: Release cells and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Vigorously shake the tube to release cells into suspension, then centrifuge at 150 g for 2 min at room temperature to collect cells and remove residual brush material.

steps.title: Incubate on ice with trituration
steps.instruction: Place the tube on ice for 30 min, performing gentle trituration with a series of needles (21 G → 22 G → 23 G) five times, spaced 5 min apart. If the sample has been stored or transported for ≥60 min, skip the 30‑min incubation and perform only the trituration steps.

steps.title: Discard brush and inspect cells
steps.instruction: Remove and discard the cytology brush, then examine the cell suspension under an inverted microscope using a Quick‑Read 10‑chamber slide (Globe Scientific catalog #3805).

steps.title: Inactivate protease
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of inactivation buffer (HBSS containing 2 % BSA; prepare by mixing 40 mL HBSS with 10 mL 10 % BSA stock) to stop protease activity.

steps.title: Centrifuge and retain pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C, then carefully discard the supernatant leaving approximately 10 µL residual liquid on the cell pellet.

steps.title: Assess red blood cell content
steps.instruction: Observe the pellet under an inverted microscope and assess RBC contamination. For quantitative assessment, add Hoechst 33342 to an aliquot and count nucleated versus non‑nucleated cells using an automated cell counter (e.g., Countess).

steps.title: Conditional RBC lysis
steps.instruction: If RBC content is ≥50 % of total cells, perform the lysis steps below; if RBC content is <50 %, skip to the next step.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.8 mL of 0.8 % ammonium chloride solution (STEMCELL Technologies catalog #7800) to 200 µL of cell suspension (9 vol ammonium chloride to 1 vol cells) in a 5 mL tube.
Add 400 µL of the inactivation buffer (HBSS + 2 % BSA).
Centrifuge at 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Resuspend pellet in 200 µL wash buffer (HBSS + 1 % BSA; prepare by mixing 20 mL HBSS with 20 mL HBSS/BSA 2 %).
Centrifuge at 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Resuspend in 250 µL wash buffer and verify successful RBC lysis.
Discard supernatant leaving ~10 µL residual liquid.
Add 1 mL wash buffer, centrifuge 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant leaving ~10 µL.
Resuspend in 500 µL wash buffer, centrifuge 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant leaving ~10 µL.
Resuspend final pellet in 50 µL resuspension buffer (HBSS + 0.05 % BSA; prepare by mixing 39 mL HBSS with 1 mL HBSS/BSA 2 %).

steps.title: Stain cells for counting
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µL of the cell suspension with 10 µL of cell‑counting solution (HBSS containing 20 µg/mL Hoechst 33342 and NucGreen). Prepare the counting solution by adding 1 µL of 10 mg/mL Hoechst 33342 stock (Thermo Fisher catalog #H3570) and one drop of NucGreen™ Dead 488 ReadyProbes™ (Thermo Fisher catalog #R37109) to 500 µL HBSS. Incubate for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the stained cell suspension through a Flowmi cell strainer (catalog #H13680‑0040) to remove aggregates.

steps.title: Wash filtered cells
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of wash buffer (HBSS + 1 % BSA) to the filtered cells and mix gently.

steps.title: Adjust final cell concentration
steps.instruction: Dilute or concentrate the suspension with wash buffer to achieve a cell density of 700–1000 cells/µL, suitable for loading onto the 10X Chromium platform. Verify the final concentration using a cell counter.
